messages.content: What errors are currently affecting our users?

The current errors affecting users are:

1. **InsufficientQuotaError (VIBEBROWSEREXTENSION-8)**: This error indicates that the user has exceeded their current quota. It has been logged 9 times in the last 24 hours, but no users are currently affected. More details can be found [here](https://vibetechnologies.sentry.io/issues/7210972124/).

2. **GraphRecursionError (VIBEBROWSEREXTENSION-2)**: This error occurs when the recursion limit of 512 is reached without hitting a stop condition. It has been logged 42 times in the last 24 hours, with no users currently affected. More details can be found [here](https://vibetechnologies.sentry.io/issues/6996178791/). 

Both errors are significant but currently do not seem to be impacting any users directly.
